title: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify PDU session parameters, which can be accepted by the network.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request modification of PDU session parameters.

entities.name: Port management information container IE
entities.description: Information element containing port management information for PDU session modification.

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to modify PDU session parameters as specified in subclause 6.3.2.

entities.name: SMF
entities.description: Session Management Function that handles PDU session modification requests and procedures.

relations.description: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure involves sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message may contain Port management information container IE.
SMF performs network-requested PDU session modification procedure upon accepting UE request.
SMF handles Port management information container IE contents as specified in TS 23.501 and TS 23.502.
